scope: A new 12-checkpoint, 36-branch held-out pilot that characterizes V6 refinement behavior under a uniformly pre-registered 1.5x task resource budget. It is not a formal H1 experiment.

budget_condition.name: HIGH_1_5X
budget_condition.rounding_rule: Exact integer family-level products only; no task-specific increase is permitted.

held_out_checkpoint_phase.eligible_checkpoint_rule: The source P0 must parse through the ordinary submit_current_plan interface, satisfy the high-budget hard task, and have at least one frozen V6 refinement gap. An ineligible source remains recorded; its three branch rows are NOT_STARTED and it is never replaced.

branch_design.checkpoint_restore_rule: Every condition starts from an isolated deep copy of the same recorded P0 current_plan and the same high-budget task material. No post-P0 plan, message, feedback, or result crosses condition boundaries.
branch_design.post_checkpoint_prompt_rule: Every branch call receives the complete latest submitted current_plan and the same high-budget task identity, forced schema, model configuration, and continuation instruction. It must submit one complete next plan and must not execute operations, explore candidates, or obtain new facts or evidence.
branch_design.early_termination_rule: After each structurally valid plan, the frozen evaluator runs in every condition. A hard task failure terminates the branch. Four satisfied refinement evaluations terminate the branch. Otherwise the shared three-call follow-up budget applies. budget_exhausted names the follow-up-call cap, not the task resource budget.

feedback.baseline: Return only a neutral acknowledgement and shared continuation instruction. Do not disclose evaluator output, refinement IDs, statuses, or gap count.
feedback.all_at_once: On each open round, return every current gap from one evaluator result, ordered by frozen priority then refinement ID.
feedback.incremental: On each open round, return only the first current gap under the same frozen priority ordering. If it remains a gap, it remains first on the next round.

state_audit.current_plan_rule: A submitted candidate is always retained as the recorded current plan for the branch. A hard-invalid candidate separately triggers the unchanged hard_task_failure terminal rule; a hard-valid regression remains the next-round current plan.

primary_metrics.plan_inflation_timing_rule: A positive plan-inflation round is the earliest post-P0 submitted plan whose recorded resource total or step count is strictly greater than P0. Post-inflation calls and token fields count only calls strictly after that submitted plan; they are unavailable when no positive plan inflation occurs.
primary_metrics.token_missingness_rule: Provider token fields are summed only when every actual post-P0 call supplies that field. Missing values remain unavailable and are never converted, inferred, or imputed to zero.
primary_metrics.residual_gap_rule: A numeric residual gap count is recorded only when the final submitted plan is hard-task-valid. A final hard-invalid plan is not_evaluable_due_to_final_hard_task_failure and is never recorded as zero or replaced by its predecessor.

paired_analysis.shared_p0_cost_handling: Source P0 provider use is recorded separately and excluded from all condition comparison totals.

primary_comparisons.question: Under the high budget, does incremental feedback coincide with greater post-P0 token use or revision depth than baseline?
Under the high budget, how does incremental feedback differ from all-at-once feedback in continued resource use and separately recorded task disruption?

paired_analysis.binary_summary: Record the paired 2x2 condition table and descriptive mean(left minus right); do not run significance tests.
paired_analysis.termination_summary: Record a right_condition by left_condition termination-reason matrix; do not convert terminal categories to a numeric score.
paired_analysis.interpretation_boundary: All comparisons characterize feedback conditions within the new high-budget held-out checkpoint set. The old V6 result is historical context only; because task instances and source P0s differ, no cross-pilot difference is interpreted as a causal budget effect.

freeze_record.rule: Before the first provider call, the V6.2 protocol, runner, analysis, tests, held-out materials, schedule, and directly read frozen dependencies must have write permission removed. Result files are locked after final analysis and status recording.

change_record: Pre-registered high-budget capacity-sensitivity protocol. It leaves the frozen V6 original budget and every earlier result untouched. The additions before freezing align recorded metric names, shared-P0 checks, plan-inflation timing diagnostics, and result-locking behavior.
